office_does: The county auditor runs elections, records documents, licenses vehicles and keeps the county's books.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Auditor Marianne Nichols, in office since 2007, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: County Auditor since 2007 and a certified election administrator; re-elected over an election-skeptic challenger in 2022.
highlights: Auditor since 2007; certified election administrator since 2009 [S1]
Past president of the Washington Association of County Auditors [S1]
Won 2022 re-election 70.7% to 27.7% over a challenger who questioned election security [S5]
